Movement within the axis is currently smooth. The stretch from Cement to Ajayi Farm via Ile Zik is clear, although there's some flash flooding at Ikeja due to earlier rainfall, but it's not significantly impacting traffic flow. 
Key routes such as National Road, PWD, Shogunle, Ladipo to Bolade intersection are all moving well.

Officers are actively managing the area to ensure a smooth tempo.
